name: aurelix-dev-launcher
description: Development launcher for the Python-based AURELIX service.

scripts.dev: sh -c 'AURELIX_OWNER_SECRET="${AURELIX_OWNER_SECRET:-$(python -c "import secrets; print(secrets.token_urlsafe(32))")}" PYTHONPATH=src AURELIX_HOST=0.0.0.0 AURELIX_PORT=8000 python -m uvicorn aurelix_core.server:app --reload'
scripts.start: PYTHONPATH=src AURELIX_HOST=0.0.0.0 AURELIX_PORT=8000 python -m uvicorn aurelix_core.server:app
